notes.title: Update 1.0.2.05 - Mutation upgrades, Mac OSX support
notes.content:
Hi, Mutants!

We're glad to present you our new update!
We re-imagined our mutations system and decided to change it a bit. Based on your feedback we found that it's not really fun to mutate into an absolutely random form. Also we got that players would like to upgrade their mutations during gameplay.

And now you can choose 3 favorite mutations before a new run which you'd like to use. Also we unlocked one more mutation from the start for new players.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28381197/243d33ffcd6d7788162195f161495ae9bea1a9ee.gif[/img]

Mutagen puddles now means more than before. At the end of each location you'll have an ability to upgrade your current mutations. We added 28 upgrades - 4 upgrades for each of 7 mutations.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28381197/1eac2fd4d9b2a81add276735ba6fa0f8340d1f06.gif[/img]

We are also really like that our game is now available for Mac OSX players!

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
 [*] Fixed the price for "Vampyre" item
 [*] Health bottles now can't be collected if yout health is full
 [*] Skill "Vampirism" fixed
 [*] The mechanics of bullets for enemies improved. It will also help with async in online co-op
 [*] Fixed headless mutation form
 [*] Fixed bug with animations on elevator screen
 [*] Fixed bug with rocket
 [*] Fixed freezing when you are collecting a new active item
 [*] Fixed bug with the collider of Wasp boss after his death
 [*] Added sounds for some locations
 [*] Fixed mechics of how you unlock items: Big saw and big bloody saw
 [*] Lots of UI improvements
[/list]

- Mandragora ːmandragoraː

Quick news:
ːfreakyeyeː [url=https://twitter.com/MandragoraTeam]Twitter[/url]
ːfreakyeyeː [url=https://www.facebook.com/TheMandragoraTeam]FB[/url]
ːfreakyeyeː [url=https://www.instagram.com/mandragorateam/]Instagram[/url]

Find friends for online co-op, talk with devs & more:
ːfreakyhandː [url=https://discord.gg/AbnzHdj]Discord[/url]

notes.content:
Hi, Mutants! ːfreakyfaceː 

Here is our next patch. We still working on the road to make our game better experience for players.

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
 [*]Cloud save fixed
 [*]Resolution bug fixed
 [*]Problem when character goes to any side when you are not control him on gamepad should be fixed now
 [*]Online co-op: Fixed problems with connecting to the lobby
 [*]Online co-op: Fixed sync problems with mutations
 [*]Online co-op: Fixed problem with color schemes
 [*]Online co-op: Fixed problem with loading and continue multyplayer sessions
 [*]Online co-op: fixed problem with multiply players on one machine
 [*]Overall online co-op should be more stable now as we fixed lots of problems in it
[/list]

That's not all. We continue working on the game. Thanks for your activity on out forums!

P.S: Are you ready to the Halloween? ːfreakyhandː

- Mandragora

We continue working on the issues. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.04
notes.content:
Hi, Mutants! ːfreakyfaceː

This patch is gonna make the game a bit easier on the first location to let you see more content faster. We have a lot of cool things but realised that most people just can't complete the Factory location..

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
 [*]Item name in shop GUI fixed
 [*]When you are getting damage your character becomes invulnerable for 1 second
 [*]Some room designs changed
 [*]"Bottle of purple liquid" is not auto-activated since now
 [*]DNA price changed from 20 to 12 coins
 [*]Vomiting enemy damage reduced by 25%
 [*]Wasp enemy's damage reduced by 30%
 [*]Price for item "Question box" changed from 5 to 1 coin
 [*]Damage from saws in Factory reduced by 30%
 [*]Damage from TNT boxes reduced by 30%
 [*]Keys to unlock Fish mutation in the Factory changed from 3 to 1
 [*]Num of rooms on the second level of the Factory reduced by 25%
 [*]Health of enemy "Larva" reduced by 20%
[/list]

- Mandragora

notes.title: Fix 0.9.0.06: Choose new mutation form
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/4xEW0Mf.gif[/img]

Hello! Today we added a new mechanics which should add some choice to the game. We faced the problem that people don't like to mutate into absolutely random form. They want to have some control on it. So, here it is!

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Now you can choose from 2 mutation forms when your character mutate!
    [*]Fixed the problem with huge amount of keys (hopefully)
    [*]There is no countdown timer when you start
    [*]Bug with buying DNA fixed
    [*]Fixed bug when easy enemy (slime) die
    [*]Fixed bug when you unlock new mutation in online co-op
    [*]Fixed bug with elevator which you could use without killing the boss in online co-op
    [*]Fixed bug with pause and waiting screens in online co-op
    [*]Fixed crash on exit game
    [*]Other minor fixes
[/list]

[h1]What’s coming soon:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Remapping keys on keyboard and gamepad (we made it, but should fix some bugs)
    [*]Adding D-pad support for the gamepad
    [*]Mouse controls support
[/list]

[b]Attention! If you'll meet the problem with continue your session from previous version, just start a new one. We will add a system for not losing saves very soon. But now it can be an issue.[/b]

If you found a bug, want to check known issues, here is the right place:
